reviews.text: The staff was very respectful and kind. I really appreciated how well the vet communicated with me, especially since I didn’t have that experience at my previous clinic. My cat was well taken care of, and I’m very happy with the visit. I’ll definitely be coming back!
Amazing veterinarian clinic.  Very friendly and caring.

This place really doesn't look appealing from the outside and looks outdated (same for the woman at the reception). It made me hesitate for my cat. However, we should never judge the book by its cover. The place is bigger than it looks and the quality of service is amazing! The receptionnist is very lovely! The vets are so kind and professional! Seeing how my cat Mochi was treated, it gave me hope since she clearly didn't like the previous clinic. The staff couldn't understand how my cat was known to be notorious in the previous clinic. It feels great to see vets who are genuinely caring, admiring my cat and not avoid her or not treating her with some secret hatred. We will keep returning to this clinic! Even my cat would sometimes jump into her carrier (she used to be too scared of the carrier as it reminded her of the previous clinic - not anymore thanks to you guys).
Fantastic team 🌟
A very friendly team, reasonable prices, and they don't push you to buy extras like many others. Thank you to Dr. Shahid, who is exceptional!
We have been customers for 9 years. The team is professional and friendly.

This vet clinic has the best staff! I’m a new dog owner and since day one I felt at home there! We walk in just to say hello, everyone greets my pup by her name and they give such amazing advice! They are very helpful and always available! Love this crew!
Amazing staff and the best care!
Excellent pet care and very little waiting time when arriving for an appointment.
First experience with a Vet. Nice welcoming and snacks for our puppy.

Been going to Baker's for 10+ years. They've taken such good care of my dogs, especially my senior dog, Snow. The staff is always so welcoming and understanding. They really are experts in care and do not try to sell you anything. Dr Zejda and Dr Tsang are incredible - they've supported us during the most difficult times and have always guided us. I've recommended Baker's to all of my friends, and not a single complaint. Wholesome and family oriented. I absolutely love Alex, the tech. She's incredibly sweet and caring. Everyone at Baker's is incredible. Highly recommend
Great vet. So helpful. Friendly happy staff.

I just wanted to say thank you to the entire staff at Bakers for all they did during Taz's battle with heart disease. Thanks to your guidance and help we turned Taz's initial bleak 3-6 months into just over 2 1/2 years. I would also like to thank Dr.Chehade for being the one to catch it and Dr.Carioto for being there whenever we needed her.

Definitely a place we would trust again if we ever chose to get another cat.
Always Phenomenal. Thank you Dr. Bereza and Carrie for your continued support of Bella.
Thank you so much for the doctor's patient examination. And thank you so much to the friendly reception staff. A very good experience. —Diamond's Mom
Awesome service, friendly staff. Excellent pricing. No hard sell for unnecessary tests or procedures. A safe place for your loved ones

Baker is simply the BEST place for your pet in this city. They always really care, and provide time to meet and TALK about our dog. The vet doc would even personally call to check up on him. They were never rushed. And when our dog had routine surgery, the dogs there got to play. And then the vet that did the surgery sat down with us, and happily engaged in a long conversation about our dog. It is far more personal and attentive than other vets. We sadly had to move vets because we live too far away now. But Baker is simply the best.

Had such a wonderful experience with Dr Mathieu Chéhadé! We needed a consultation for our new kitten and he was very kind, attentive, and helpful (as was the whole clinic staff). The prices for the services were very reasonable and we could tell how much everyone working there genuinely cared about the wellbeing of pets/animals. We’re so happy to have found this clinic and will certainly be coming back when needed. Thank you again to the whole team!

We had an emergency situation with our cat, and the staff were incredible!
They accepted us immediately, treated our cat gently, and explained everything with care and patience.
Everyone was so kind and understanding — we truly felt that they cared.
Thank you for helping us during such a stressful moment!

I want to thank all the staff for the care they have given my dog for the last 14 years. Even during the last difficult day, I can't think of a better group if people to have helped me through this. I can't find the words to say thank you properly.

Ill never get over how they were pushing for euthanasia when our dog only had a gastritis
They didn’t even want to hear another vets opinion who was convinced our dog was fine.
He was, he recovered but we could’ve given in and had less “guts” and just accept the professional opinion from that hospital.
Our dog was 13 then and it seemed like old age = what’s the point.
Our dog is now 17 and 2 months and we really just wish they would’ve been more thorough and considerate and at least try to listen to another expert opinion.
In the end it was fine, we still did the IV treatment at baker and our dog recovered but the way they really pushed for that euthanasia was heart wrenching.
Obviously the direct emotional investment is making us write a review like this, they were great for years to our dog. It’s just that after a traumatizing experience like this we really had to cut ties.
Excellent service 👍🏽👍🏽 …

Absolutely love this clinic!
Took my kitten Toutou here to get neutered, and I couldn’t be more grateful for how well they treated him (and us!). The staff is always so kind, patient, and gentle with him, you can really tell they care. Tputou recovered beautifully, and every visit has been a positive experience. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️
Going here for the past 2 years, for my cat!! The staff is super professional, and the vets are very knowledgeable!!

The people here are really super! They're kind, caring and patient. They answer all your questions and don't rush you. They really care and enjoy their work... This is a ten ⭐!!! I really can't say enough great things about the staff they're grrrrrrrrreat!!! If you need a vet, this is the place and they have parking too 👍 Absolutely no complaints 👍 Still the best❤️
We have been happy customers/clients with Baker since we added a puppy to our family nearly 7 years ago. We love the team there. They are great especially that our dog is the anxious type.
Amazing :)
Wonderful people with great bedside manners.

Experienced and professional staff, very attentive and thorough. Take great care of their patients and their parents too! excellent service with follow ups through email with the experienced technicians that answer questions and offer solutions! Baker Animal Hospital is Wonderful!🧡🩷💚 …
There is no other vet I would trust than Bakers. The best staff, nicest people and all around best service you can ask for when it comes to caring for your fur babies.
This is the best and best veterinary clinic.

My pets always receive good care here and everyone is really friendly. Veterinary care is pretty expensive, but the vets here have never taken advantage of me-- they have saved me money by not suggesting /pressuring me into redundant/unnecessary procedures.
A very warm welcome and very professional service; my dog ​​enjoyed it too! 🐾🥰 …

My brother and I have been clients of this Clinique for the past couple of years. They have a caring, attentive and passionate team serving their clients to the best of their abilities. Our experience is unparalleled to anything we had seen before. We wish them continued success and you should definitely give them a try. Best of luck to the team.
They are good but expensive
Staff are very nice and respectful.  Such kind-hearted people, and it really shows in what they do. I highly recommend bringing your little fury family here.
Excellent service! Very competent veterinarians
